{{Youmay|the organisms used to create a lair.|another [[Unidentified organism (wedge)|organism]] that [[Nom Anor]] created.}}
[[Nom Anor]] [[Bioengineering/Legends|created]] an '''organism''' that in large numbers helped him dig a lair for himself in the stone ground of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. When they died, the organisms released the bacteria in their guts, which started the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] process for Duro.
